title: Standing
description: One row per obligation, read by the public board and by the Ask box. A missing or null value is reported as 'no-data', never a fake green.

history.description: Track record over a trailing window, measured from receipts and records — never from the current date alone. null means the window held no past deadline with a receipt-dated outcome: the board says 'no history yet', never a fabricated zero. Optional until the next release: a vault whose core predates history omits the key, and a consumer treats an absent history like null. evaluate.py always emits it.

window_days.description: Width of the trailing window in days.

evaluated.description: Past deadlines in the window that had a receipt-dated outcome. At least 1 whenever history is non-null; otherwise history is null.

breaches.description: How many of the evaluated deadlines were red at the deadline. A later timely posting never retires a breach that already happened.
